lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice making soft suggestions with skulle kunna.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two colleagues consider options for lunch, fika, or a low-key after-work activity.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Suggesting plans politely without sounding too direct.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss what to do during lunch or after work and propose options politely.

main_focus.name: soft suggestions with skulle kunna
main_focus.description: Use skulle kunna plus infinitive to make a suggestion sound tentative and friendly.
model_examples: Vi skulle kunna prova det nya kaféet.
Du skulle kunna följa med om du vill.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use skulle kunna naturally 2-3 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use polite suggestion and response chunks in a practical planning exchange.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person asks what they should do for lunch, fika, or after work.
dialogue_shape.middle: They suggest one or two options softly and respond politely.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose an option or leave the invitation open.

target_complexity.repetition: use skulle kunna enough to establish the polite suggestion pattern

focus: what final arrangement or open invitation remains

sentence_focus: one sentence with vi skulle kunna
one sentence with du skulle kunna
one sentence politely declining a suggestion
one sentence adding om du vill to soften an invitation
